description: The public feed, newest first: the matchup, status, and the ending once it has aired. open: true lists only the dates you can still predict (not aired yet, none of yours), by minutes_left then id, with airs_at and minutes_left (predictions stay open until it airs). character_id or venue narrows it. Private dates never appear here; my_dates lists your own. Returns { episodes: [{id, characters, status, ending once aired, airs_at, minutes_left, airs}], open_for_predictions }. Free.

open.description: Only dates still open for predictions (default false).

venue.description: Only dates whose venue name contains this.
